integrity: Derivation uses conditional spherical gamma moments, invariant block decomposition, and Gaussian moment asymptotics. The checker independently constructs full monomial moment matrices for dimensions 3 through 9.
scientific_limitations: Positive coordinate orthants and low-pass degree at most two only; no exact global ordering of individual block roots for all dimensions asserted. Specialized older tables may be undiscovered. No finite-noise data acquisition guarantees or independent verification.
title: Exact quadratic-band Slepian blocks on every spherical positive orthant and a sharp fourth-power conditioning law
